Offline English Voice runtime

Runtime package versions:
- kokoro-js 1.2.1 (Apache-2.0), https://github.com/hexgrad/kokoro/tree/664c76a704021239ba59c84dcbaa4d3dece01fe9/kokoro.js
- @huggingface/transformers 3.5.1 (Apache-2.0), https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js
- phonemizer 1.2.1 (declared Apache-2.0), https://github.com/xenova/phonemizer.js/tree/6835144b7ee9043129222549c1ed2f6a27216278
- ONNX Runtime Web 1.22.0-dev.20250409-89f8206ba4 (MIT), https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
Licenses and ONNX third-party notices are included alongside this file.

The phonemizer includes compiled eSpeak NG code/data. eSpeak NG is a
GPL-3.0-or-later project: https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng
Its license is included as LICENSE-espeak-ng.txt. Upstream source and
compilation wrapper used by phonemizer are available at the pinned source
link above (src/espeakng.worker.js and data/). No voice recording or
third-party application content is bundled.

Local modifications:
- runtime-source.mjs supplies an explicit cached voice adapter and checks
  the token limit instead of silently truncating long sentences.
- The build rewrites the otherwise unused upstream voice loader URL to
  the pinned model revision. Actual model loading uses the prepared Cache
  API with local_files_only=true; generated text is not sent to a server.
- ONNX runs single-threaded WASM in a Worker, avoiding a cross-origin
  isolation requirement. All runtime dependencies are served locally.

Model (downloaded on request, not distributed in this repository):
onnx-community/Kokoro-82M-v1.0-ONNX, Apache-2.0
